prompts.title: Detailed Pencil Sketch of Man in Flat Cap
prompts.prompt:
Create a highly detailed black-and-white graphite and ink portrait sketch of a man wearing a dark classic flat cap, rectangular eyeglasses, and a dark, heavy high-collared jacket. Show him in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the right, with a serious, calm expression.
Capture realistic facial proportions, prominent nose, deep-set eyes behind the glasses, thick eyebrows, detailed hair visible beneath the cap. Render the hair, eyebrows, and skin with extremely fine individual strokes.
Use a micro-detail hand-drawn sketch style with layered graphite shading, cross-hatching, fine contour lines, loose construction strokes, and subtle white pencil highlights. Add detailed linework to the fabric folds, raised collar, buttons, cap texture, and eyeglass frames. Maintain visible sketch strokes rather than a perfectly polished digital illustration.
Lighting: A soft directional light comes from the right side of the image, gently illuminating the right side of the face, and coat, creating subtle highlights and enhanced facial definition. The opposite side remains slightly darker with soft, natural graphite shading.
Use a light gray textured paper background, monochrome grayscale tones, strong but natural contrast, subtle shadows, and an authentic traditional pencil-and-ink drawing appearance.
Style: ultra-detailed graphite portrait, monochrome pencil sketch, super-fine cross-hatching, realistic hand-drawn linework, micro-detail, textured paper, editorial portrait illustration, highly refined traditional sketch, 8K detail. Aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: Dramatic Graphic Illustration of a Gentleman
prompts.prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 high-resolution black-and-white graphic-novel illustration with a bold red-and-black splash-art aesthetic. Show a man in a dramatic chest-up three-quarter pose, body turned slightly away while looking toward the viewer, framed from approximately the mid-chest upward. His expression should be serious, intense, calm, and confident, with a strong cinematic presence.
He is dressed in a sharp black formal suit jacket with realistic structured tailoring, subtle fabric folds, and deep black shadows. Under the jacket, include a crisp white dress shirt with an open collar, creating strong contrast against the dark suit. Emphasize the angular structure of the clothing using bold ink outlines, cross-hatching, stippling, and comic-book shadow work.
Use a high-contrast monochrome illustration technique for the entire subject: pure blacks, whites, and multiple shades of gray. Add detailed cross-hatched engraving lines, fine ink strokes, stippling, rough pencil textures, and graphic-novel shading throughout the face, clothing, and exposed areas. The lighting should be dramatic and directional, creating bright highlights on one side and deep black shadows on the opposite side.
The background should feature a large, abstract red paint-splash composition covering and extending behind the subject. Surround it with numerous black and red ink splatters, droplets, irregular brush marks, scattered particles, and explosive paint strokes. Keep portions of the background clean white to create strong contrast and make the red and black elements stand out dramatically.
The overall composition should feel like a premium comic-book character poster / graphic novel cover, with a gritty hand-inked appearance, dynamic contrast, strong silhouette, editorial poster composition, and cinematic intensity.
Style: ultra-detailed black-and-white graphic novel, hand-inked comic illustration, realistic proportions, engraved illustration, cross-hatching, stippling, rough ink texture, high contrast, dramatic lighting, bold contour lines, red-and-black poster aesthetic, sophisticated editorial artwork.
Composition: vertical 4:5, centered subject, three-quarter view, chest-up portrait, subject occupying most of the frame, clean silhouette, strong visual hierarchy, red paint splash behind the subject.
Color palette: monochrome black, white, and grayscale for the character, with vivid deep crimson red used exclusively for the background paint splashes and selected splatter accents.
Quality: highly detailed, sharp inkwork, crisp edges, intricate textures, professional comic-book illustration, 8K quality, poster-ready, no text, no logo, no watermark.

He  wears sleek black rectangular sunglasses while gazing slightly to the right with a calm, confident expression. He is dressed in an oversized off-white short-sleeve button-up shirt tucked into tailored black high-waisted trousers with a black leather belt, complemented by a minimalist black wristwatch. prompts.title: A Moment of Clarity
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly ONLY for 100% accurate face matching and identity reference.
Create a hyper-realistic black & white graphite digital portrait with an elegant fine-art illustration aesthetic. The artwork depicts a handsome man rendered entirely in detailed graphite pencil, featuring natural styled hair, and realistic facial textures with smooth tonal transitions. Every strand of hair and facial contour is illustrated with meticulous pencil strokes, creating a museum-quality graphite drawing.
Pose & Composition:
The subject is shown in a centered bust portrait, cropped from the upper chest upward. He faces directly toward the camera with a calm yet intense expression. His right hand is thoughtfully positioned beneath his chin, with the index finger extending naturally along the jawline, creating a confident contemplative pose. His shoulders remain relaxed and square to the camera, resulting in a balanced, symmetrical composition.
Wardrobe & Accessories:
He wears a simple dark black crew-neck t-shirt rendered with realistic graphite shading and subtle fabric texture. Two minimalist metallic rings adorn his fingers, adding understated contemporary style without distracting from the portrait.
Artistic Effects:
Soft, translucent streams of ethereal smoke gracefully swirl around the lower torso, shoulders, neck, and flow upward behind the head, blending naturally into the composition. The smoke is delicately rendered with semi-transparent graphite tones, creating an atmospheric and dreamlike effect. Fine graphite dust, subtle ink splatters, scattered charcoal particles, and delicate sketch debris are dispersed around the figure, enhancing the handcrafted artistic appearance while maintaining a clean, sophisticated composition.
Background:
A pure white minimalist background with abundant negative space, allowing the portrait and swirling smoke to remain the sole visual focus. No additional objects or scenery are present.
Lighting:
Soft diffused studio lighting with gentle frontal illumination, producing smooth gradients across the face while preserving deep graphite shadows. High-contrast pencil shading emphasizes the facial structure, jawline, hair volume, and hand anatomy without harsh highlights.
Camera & Framing:
Eye-level camera angle, medium-close bust composition, centered framing, approximately an 85mm portrait lens perspective for natural proportions and refined facial compression.
Style & Quality:
Hyper-realistic graphite illustration, ultra-detailed pencil rendering, masterful cross-hatching, smooth tonal blending, intricate hair detailing, realistic skin textures, visible pores, fine-art portrait drawing, premium editorial aesthetic, elegant monochrome composition, ultra-high resolution, 8K, museum-quality craftsmanship
Aspect ratio 4:5

prompts.title: The Cafe Window
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly only for the woman’s facial identity and natural features. Preserve her face shape, facial proportions, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, skin tone, and overall likeness accurately. Keep her natural hair color from the reference, but style it as described below.
Create a high-resolution traditional blue ballpoint pen (Biro) illustration on lightly textured warm off-white paper, in a vertical 4:5 composition. The image should look hand-drawn with refined navy-blue ink linework, realistic pen pressure variation, delicate contour lines, dense cross-hatching, and visible paper grain. Add a subtle warm sepia/golden sunlight tint entering from the right side, blending naturally with the cool blue ink shadows.
Show the woman seated at a wooden café table in a three-quarter side composition. Her body is angled slightly toward the left while her face is turned toward the right, gazing pensively out of frame with a quiet, thoughtful expression. One elbow rests on the tabletop and the matching hand gently supports her cheek and chin; her other arm rests naturally across her lap. Her pose should feel relaxed, candid, and emotionally reflective.
Give her a messy loose bun/updo with fluid overlapping ink strokes, softly textured strands, and a few natural loose tendrils around her temples, cheeks, and neck. She wears a loose dark short-sleeve t-shirt and dark pants, rendered with rich near-solid navy ink, deep folds, and dense multidirectional cross-hatching. Keep her face softly luminous with sparse fine hatching, expressive eyes, defined lashes, natural brows, a straight nose, and softly parted full lips.
In front of her, place an open spiral-bound notebook on the wooden plank table. Fill the pages with small illegible handwritten notes and abstract sketches only, with no readable words. Add a small geometric triangle-like diagram on one page and a dark blue pen placed diagonally across the notebook. To the right, include an open zippered pencil pouch with several pens visible inside. Behind the notebook, place a white ceramic coffee mug on a saucer with a small spoon and subtle rising steam drawn using thin, soft negative-space lines.
Use visible wood grain, plank gaps, and linear hatching across the tabletop, with the warm sunlight becoming more prominent toward the right edge. Seat her on a slatted wooden chair with curved ink hatching and realistic structure.
Create a softly detailed café background: a bright window on the right as the source of warm light, wooden cabinetry and potted plants on the left, a hanging plant or pendant lamp above, and a distant café guest seated with their back turned near the window. Keep all background elements lighter, softer, and less densely drawn than the woman and table objects, creating natural atmospheric depth and focus separation.
The woman, notebook, mug, and pencil pouch should have crisp, high-contrast, highly detailed blue ink lines. The background should remain airy and understated. Let the portrait and surrounding linework softly dissolve and fade into the paper around all four outer edges of the composition, especially near the corners and border, so the image blends naturally into the off-white paper instead of ending with hard defined edges. No photorealistic colors, no painted brushstrokes, no cartoon look, no thick black outlines, no readable text, no distorted hands, no extra fingers, no overly smooth skin.

prompts.title: The Inspired Dreamer
prompts.prompt:
Transform the uploaded woman into a premium 4:5 vertical semi-realistic digital illustration drawn directly on white lined notebook paper. The artwork should look like it is painted and sketched on the paper surface, not pasted as a sticker, not a cut-out, and not separated from the background.
Use the uploaded image for face and identity reference and redrawn in this soft illustration style, not a generic cartoon character.
Show her sitting cross-legged in the center of the page. Keep the pose natural, relaxed, and slightly imperfect, not stiff or symmetrical. Her upper body should gently tilt to one side, with soft relaxed shoulders, a calm seated posture, and hands resting naturally near the ankles. The body language should feel effortless, feminine, and candid, as if she is sitting comfortably and lost in her own thoughts.
Her head is slightly raised and turned upward to one side. Her eyes look away thoughtfully, with a soft dreamy expression and a gentle subtle smile, giving the feeling that she is quietly imagining something.
Dress her in a white fitted sleeveless ribbed tank top, light blue high-waisted jeans with rolled cuffs, and off-white canvas sneakers with laces. Add black round eyeglasses, small hoop earrings, and a delicate necklace.
Render the artwork in a soft high-detail digital painting style with hand-drawn paper texture:


smooth natural skin shading

refined soft facial details

rich flowing hair with layered strands and gentle highlights

detailed denim folds and sneaker details

clean but delicate linework

subtle paper-grain texture visible through the artwork

soft warm lighting and premium feminine illustration quality
The subject should blend naturally with the notebook page, as if the illustration was created directly on the paper, with no thick white border, no sticker outline, no cut-out edge, and no drop shadow around the body.
Background: white ruled notebook paper with faint horizontal lines and subtle paper texture. At the top-left corner, add a small beige paper heart clipped with a metallic paperclip.
Around the subject, add light scrapbook-style hand-drawn doodles in black and warm beige: curved arrows, dotted lines, sparkles, hearts, accent strokes, and a small lightbulb doodle. Add handwritten motivational words around her: BRAVE, DREAMER, CREATIVE, INSPIRED, CONFIDENT. The words should look hand-drawn on the notebook page or lightly sketched onto the page, not sticker labels.
Final look: soft, premium, feminine, semi-realistic notebook-page illustration, airy and detailed, with a natural tilted pose and thoughtful dreamy mood.
Negative instructions: no sticker cutout, no thick white outline, no drop shadow around the subject, no pasted-paper effect, no chibi style, no mascot look, no flat vector art, no childish cartoon, no stiff pose, no generic face, no face and identity change.
